initial_messages.content: Repair invoice.summary(lines, discount): each line has sku, quantity and unit_price as decimal strings. Merge repeated SKUs by summing their discounted amounts. Apply a fractional discount before rounding each merged SKU total to two decimal places using ROUND_HALF_UP. Return a dict of SKU to formatted amount strings. Reject negative quantity/price and discounts outside [0,1]. Preserve input data.
